strings.name: Eminem
strings.summary: Eminem moved from Detroit’s underground into mainstream rap, combining intricate rhyme, autobiography and fictional personas. He starred in 8 Mile and shared the song Oscar for Lose Yourself. His lyrics drew criticism for misogyny, homophobia and violence; his work also addresses addiction and recovery. He entered the Rock Hall in 2022.

strings.influence.rationale: Through intricate rhyme, character-based storytelling and personal experience, he expanded rap’s audience and had a lasting impact on hip-hop’s global spread and lyrical expression.
